recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-36190 follow-up is needed unless a separate future MetadataResource-pattern decision changes the shared interface or rendering behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-36190 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that ConceptMap align with the MetadataResource pattern because it is a knowledge artifact with the same content-management lifecycle concerns as other knowledge artifacts.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Jira links PR #2066; git history shows commit 8623473ddfcef0cb88b9abf5241abfe6e28ea542 changed ConceptMap's baseDefinition from CanonicalResource to MetadataResource during the ConceptMap2 merge, and commit dabe1b3960607660a2f3f43e7e9cc4f6857ee971 changed the ConceptMap template to MetadataResource and added lifecycle elements, examples, and related search parameter updates for J#36190.
additional_context: ConceptMap is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml declares the MetadataResource template and baseDefinition and includes the MetadataResource lifecycle elements added for the issue. Vocab minutes from 2022-04-11 record the issue as resolved change required, and 2022-07-21 minutes state that ConceptMap (FHIR-36190) and NamingSystem (FHIR-36191) had been updated to be MetadataResources. FHIR-36191 is related but already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because the authoritative current source already satisfies the Jira request. Adding duplicate narrative or editing generated-looking diagram output would not materially improve the specification.

related_jiras.note: Parallel Published/Persuasive Vocab issue for NamingSystem becoming a MetadataResource; it was applied in the same implementation family and already has a combined-branch audit commit, so it was not decided again here.
